description: A studio distribution executive must approve the final delivery package for a filmed concert special, including territories, credit language, technical master, captions, and publicity release timing, after the relevant departments complete their routine package signoff.

shared_context.S1: The studio is preparing the filmed concert special "Midnight Arcade" for delivery to a broadcast partner.
shared_context.S2: The current draft package lists worldwide delivery, the studio's standard music credit, a 4K UHD 24 fps master, English subtitles, and a June 14 publicity release.
shared_context.S3: Mara has final approval authority for the delivery package.
shared_context.S4: The studio's package-lock routine is a department-by-department signoff in which rights, post-production, and publicity each report any required changes before Mara approves the package.

PF1.text: Jonah reviewed the countersigned music license this morning and confirmed that the concert may be distributed only in the United States and Canada; the required credit is exactly "Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs." He has not entered the countersigned terms into the delivery tracker yet because the rights database migration is still open.

PF2.text: Leila received the broadcaster's completed ingest test today and confirmed that delivery must be an IMF package at 25 fps with English SDH captions; the draft 4K UHD 24 fps master and ordinary English subtitle file will fail the partner's ingest specification. She kept the result in the post-production test folder pending the routine package-lock meeting.

PF3.text: Rafael confirmed with the artist's representative this afternoon that publicity for the special is embargoed until June 21, and the representative will reject any public release dated earlier than June 21. The approval email is still attached to the publicity calendar rather than the delivery tracker.

acceptance_conditions: The package must be approved for delivery only in the United States and Canada.
The music credit must use the exact Northline Songs wording.
The technical master must be an IMF package at 25 fps.
The caption file must be English SDH.
Publicity release must be dated June 21.
A rights-record update commitment must be logged.
A technical-repackage commitment must be logged.
An artist-embargo commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C1: decisions['delivery_approved'] == True or (decisions['delivery_approved'] == False and len(commitments) >= 3 and decisions['territories'] == ['United States', 'Canada'] and decisions['master_format'] == 'IMF package at 25 fps' and decisions['caption_format'] == 'English SDH captions' and decisions['publicity_release_date'] == 'June 21')
content_checks.C3: decisions['music_credit'] == 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs' or decisions['music_credit'] == 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs.'
content_checks.C7: decisions['territories'] == ['United States', 'Canada'] and (decisions['music_credit'] == 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs' or decisions['music_credit'] == 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs.')
content_checks.C8: decisions['master_format'] == 'IMF package at 25 fps' and decisions['caption_format'] == 'English SDH captions'

decisive_facts.why: The countersigned license changes delivery from worldwide to exactly the United States and Canada, replaces the standard credit with the exact Northline Songs wording, and supplies the terms needed for the rights-record update.
The broadcaster's ingest result changes the master to exactly 'IMF package at 25 fps,' changes the caption field to exactly 'English SDH captions,' and requires the technical-repackage commitment.
The artist's confirmed embargo changes the publicity release date from June 14 to exactly June 21 and requires the artist-embargo commitment.
